environment: Organization: personal project (shogotasai). Primary use: hobby OSS web service development with the project-autopilot unattended pipeline (host mode + Remote Control)
Repository visibility: private during development, planned to become public OSS (github.com/shogotasai/oriorimap)

Cloud provider(s): AWS (ap-northeast-1, SAM/CloudFormation). Actual cloud changes go through CI (deploy-dev.yml) only; agent-initiated apply/deploy is not expected in unattended runs. Interactive IaC tasks are run with the human present

Autopilot run artifacts: task-PM agents record per-task state and evidence under .agent-tasks/<TASK_ID>/ inside the repository and its worktrees (report.md, escalation.md, events.jsonl, status.json, evidence/); these are internal pipeline work records

Fixed entry points: shell operations needed by the pipeline are wrapped as registry scripts under scripts/agent/ (worker-launch.sh, wt-setup.sh, wt-push.sh, pr-create.sh, pr-label.sh, notify.sh, verdict.sh) and as herdr verbs (herdr pane / herdr wait / herdr agent); a PreToolUse hook (agent-gate.sh) verifies registry scripts against SHA-256 hashes pinned in .claude/hooks/agent-gate.manifest.json before allowing them
